body: Deferred by the owner on 2026-10-13. Brokers are transports and trigger sources, never the source of truth: a broker backend is store + dispatcher + broker. The library keeps schedules and long delays in its own store and hands due work to the broker; declare what a broker-only setup cannot do (SQS: 15 min max delay, 5 min FIFO dedup, 1 MiB payload). Separate module per broker so its SDK never reaches the core.
title: Message broker transports: SQS, SNS, EventBridge (and NATS/RabbitMQ later)
